title: Bitcoin realized-volatility compression below QQQ

source.image_description: TradingView chart comparing BTC and QQQ 30-day realized volatility, with historical BTC buy markers near periods when BTC realized volatility fell to or below QQQ realized volatility.
source_limitations: The full tweet text is not independently archived in the repository.
The image does not expose machine-readable marker dates or indicator code.
Historical chart annotations are candidacy evidence, not untouched validation.

canonical_hypothesis: When Bitcoin 30-calendar-day realized volatility crosses below QQQ 30-calendar-day realized volatility, Bitcoin enters an unusually compressed volatility regime relative to large-cap US technology equities and may earn stronger forward returns than calendar-year-matched unconditional Bitcoin entries.

canonical_trigger.annualization: sqrt(365) for BTC and sqrt(252) for QQQ
canonical_trigger.alignment_rule: Compare after the regular QQQ close using QQQ adjusted closes and only completed BTC UTC daily closes available by the decision timestamp.
canonical_trigger.entry_event: Fresh crossover from BTC realized volatility greater than or equal to QQQ realized volatility to strictly below it.
canonical_trigger.anti_churn_rule: Re-arm only after BTC realized volatility returns to greater than or equal to QQQ realized volatility.

execution_definition.entry: First completed BTC UTC daily close strictly after the QQQ-close decision timestamp

diagnostic_exit: First comparable recross to BTC realized volatility greater than or equal to QQQ realized volatility

primary_success_target.metric: mean after-cost return improvement relative to the absolute mean of a calendar-year and source-exposure-matched unconditional benchmark

decision.reason: The rule cleared the predeclared historical improvement target, but overlapping trigger clusters leave only six independent 90-day episodes, only two are in the source-exposed validation segment, the worst historical adverse excursion was about 50%, and no untouched prospective outcome exists.

production_gate.required_primary_edge: positive and at least 25% above the frozen matched benchmark
production_gate.required_regime_coverage: positive evidence in more than one predeclared regime

governance_note: Canonical before enhanced. Watchlist status authorizes automated observation only and grants no capital rights.
